title: Workspace order, view shortcut, panel folding and proxy routing
description: Cycle the sidebar between WorkSpace, Workspace Tree and the single list with a configurable shortcut, fold the global panels behind More once they exceed a configurable count in a user-defined order that a long-press drag can rewrite, order workspaces by their newest conversation, make the per-workspace conversation count configurable, remember a model per workspace, and edit a past user message in place; it also decides per provider whether LLM requests go through a proxy, with the proxy URL and provider rules set on a settings page.
